authority: Primary approved this proposal before final model scores; full plan authorized by user
evaluation_population: All rights-eligible publisher-test questions with at least one original answerable human alternative whose entire original evidence aligns to allowed text. Preserve alternatives; never create evidence unions.
request_scope_amendment: Primary approved before final scores: each QASPER request is bound to its original publisher paper identity, obtained before answers/evidence; same scope for baseline and every candidate. Hotpot final requests search the entire cross-document final collection, never an oracle restriction to that question's ten supplied contexts. Preserve failed global-QASPER development receipt and report dataset-family metrics.

additional_final_holdout.selection: First512 question IDs by SHA256('airk.hotpot.final.v1:'+ID), before model scoring; preserve original validation tag and never use any publisher validation rows for training/calibration/development
additional_final_holdout.authority: Primary approved private evaluation/development CC BY-SA4 fixtures, separately prohibiting distributable weight training on HotpotQA absent further rights closure
additional_final_holdout.conditions: Attribution, original article URLs, license/change record; derived fixture CC BY-SA4. Public benchmark/pretraining contamination disclosed. Require provided evidence and valid citations; no query-only memorization credit.

int8_export_admission.authority: Primary froze before reviewing quantization results
int8_export_admission.scope: Approximate export admission to full profile qualification only; softmax is a diagnostic, not calibrated probability. Actual INT8 context/citation/quality/resource/cancel gates remain mandatory, no FP32 substitution or implicit precision fallback.

abstention.population: Original unanimously human-unanswerable alternatives; answerable/unanswerable disagreements reported separately and excluded from binary sufficiency gate

intervals.role: descriptive uncertainty; not a 99% noninferiority claim

downstream.population: First100 eligible final task IDs ordered by SHA256('airk.goal.final.v1:'+ID), no score-based selection
downstream.turn_population: Paired common-success questions; also report all-task turns and failures to disclose selection bias
downstream.requirements: Fixed capable local model/agent, same total canonical read/token/byte/deadline budget, actual original human answers coupled to complete same-alternative support citations and source receipt coverage. Ordinary baseline gets legitimate followups. Count all internal reads and Arbiter compute separately. No repository workspace upload; no post-holdout tuning;95%descriptive intervals.

limitations: QASPER single-version rights subset alone has only 44 publisher-test questions/14papers before alignment exclusions and fails the population floor. More licensed human data is needed. No final model scoring preceded this freeze. This record grants no production model promotion.
